triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

**Released by the maintainer** (recorded on objectstack-ai/objectstack#34659 at 23:01Z, comment 6963538703: 「云端的任务你说暂缓，他也不会排的呀，是不是应该先放回队列」 and 「其他技能体系的卡如果改动面大不是理由啊…那就应该开放」). `pm:on-hold` → `pm:queue`. Theme: MCP, epic objectstack-ai/objectstack#34659 (in focus).

Named effect: hosted MCP clients are served TypeScript examples for JSON they must write, and a renamed section heading would break the hosted product at start with nothing here to catch it. So p1.

epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

The input list this card needs, written 2026-11-18T02:40Z. The card said it was on the cloud handover card; it was not there, and that was this session's error. Answering objectstack-ai/objectstack#34659 comment 6965488995.

Read from the hosted door's own reference table (`packages/service-ai-studio/src/skills/published-refs.ts`, cloud `53a5844`, 120 lines). The hosted door finds a section by its exact heading text, outside code fences; the heading must occur exactly once in its file, and the section runs to the next heading of the same or a higher level. A renamed, removed or duplicated heading throws there at module load. 24 sections:

**`skills/objectstack-data`** (9)

| File | Heading, exactly as matched |
|:---|:---|
| `rules/naming.md` | Critical Rules (the hosted door reads list item 6 of this section) |
| `SKILL.md` | Object Definition |
| `SKILL.md` | Field Type Selection |
| `SKILL.md` | Relationship Patterns |
| `SKILL.md` | Validation Patterns |
| `rules/validation.md` | State Machine Validation |
| `rules/relationships.md` | Roll-up Summaries |
| `references/seeds.md` | Seed best practices |
| `rules/lifecycle.md` | Save Notice |

**`skills/objectstack-ui`** (3)

| File | Heading, exactly as matched |
|:---|:---|
| `SKILL.md` | List Views |
| `SKILL.md` | Actions |
| `rules/list-views.md` | Adding a board, calendar, gallery or gantt beside the list |

**`skills/objectstack-automation`** (12)

| File | Heading, exactly as matched |
|:---|:---|
| `SKILL.md` | Data Operations |
| `SKILL.md` | External Integration |
| `SKILL.md` | \`notify\` (the heading text is the word notify in backticks) |
| `SKILL.md` | Failure routing & \`runAs\` |
| `SKILL.md` | Filter operands (\`config.filter\`) |
| `SKILL.md` | Valid-but-silently-wrong (passes build, fails at runtime) |
| `SKILL.md` | Integrations are declared, not coded |
| `references/examples-flows.md` | Time-relative triggers — scheduled per-record date sweep |
| `references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` | Approvals (Flow Nodes) |
| `references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` | Approver Types |
| `references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` | Node Config (\`ApprovalNodeConfigSchema\`) |
| `references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` | Approval Best Practices |

Notes for the guard and the JSON forms:

- Two of the automation sections are also served in a variant with passages replaced for the hosted tier (the `runAs: 'system'` lines). The headings are the same two; the guard needs no extra entry, but a JSON form added inside those sections should not break the passages being replaced, which only the cloud side can check.
- The list is as of the hosted pin read above. If the cloud's table has moved since, the cloud seat's reading wins; the guard's list is then a file this card owns and the cloud PM updates by PR.
- "About 25" in the design record was this session's loose count; the table has 24 distinct sections.
